key_obstacle.finding: The naive bridge HAValid phi -> theory-parametric-premise does NOT hold: AlgTValid only forces bot_val to be a lower bound on the image of v (via efq), not the algebra's canonical bottom; a GHA may have no bottom. Therefore the COMPLETENESS (backward) direction of each tier corollary cannot be sourced from the validity-predicate; it must reuse the original Lindenbaum instantiation (canonicalV/canonicalBotVal with the rfl bridge ⊥ = canonicalBotVal). The SOUNDNESS (forward) direction recovers cleanly by instantiating the new theorem at bot_val = ⊥ and discharging AlgTValid via the existing *_alg_axiom_sound lemmas.
key_obstacle.resolution: Each tier corollary is proved by an explicit two-direction proof: forward via hilbert_alg_complete_theory.mp + *_alg_axiom_sound; backward via the existing Lindenbaum route (canonicalV_spec + hilbertLindenbaumMk_eq_top_iff). For IPL/CPL the rfl bridge `(⊥ : HilbertLindenbaumAlgebra _) = canonicalBotVal _` is reused verbatim from current HilbertCompleteness.lean.
